newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hagemeyer sees major sales growth ahead.
newsitem.headline: Hagemeyer sees major sales growth ahead.

text.p: Trading company Hagemeyer NV said on Wednesday it expected an increase in turnover to about 11 or 12 billion guilders in the next few years from around eight billion currently.
"We aim for an increase in turnover of 12 to 15 percent annually, partly because of acquisitions," chairman Andrew Land told a news conference.
He added half of the growth would be organic and the remainder through takeovers.
Hagemeyer now generates about 60 percent of its turnover in Europe, 20 percent in the Americas and 20 percent in Asia.
In about about five years or so, half of the group's sales should come from Europe, with the other 50 percent more or less evenly divided between the Americas and Asia, Land said.
He added that Hagemeyer would continue to seek acquisitions in Asia and the U.S. in particular but did not elaborate.

Earlier, Hagemeyer said its 1996 net profit had surged by 47.5 percent to 285.2 million guilders and turnover by 43.6 percent to 8.22 billion. Hong Kong's First Pacific Co owns a controlling stake in Hagemeyer.
